_doc: One business's Lead Radar settings. No key or token goes in this file (the owner's standing rule on secrets). Everything else here is a setting to change freely.
offer: a free listing in a directory where businesses find each other for collaborations, partnerships, sponsorships, deals and commission referral campaigns
buyer: a business owner asking in public for a partner: someone to collaborate with, a sponsor or something to sponsor, a referral partner, a deal
leave_outs: people selling leads, lists or a networking membership
how-to questions with no need behind them

routes._doc: The four routes. The data route is named here and not built yet.

community_leads.note: Justin, 2026-11-24: "it's going to hit SKOOL and WAP" (Whop). Public pages are read as they are; a community that needs a member sign-in waits on Justin signing the bot in to it

sources._doc: Which sources are on. With account owner, Treg is reached inside One API. With account client, one-api is off.

lead-radar-agent.note: the standalone Lead Radar agent, where the business runs one; its leads go to the sales agent like any other source

metamuse.note: reads Facebook and Instagram through the owner's own Meta account, where the business has it set up

channels._doc: via: account means the source the account setting gives (One API for the owner, Treg for a client). read holds the tool ids found in the catalog for that channel. terms are the phrases people use when they ask.

terms: looking for businesses to collaborate with

places: private groups, by link: read through a signed-in browser
the Skool groups joined, by link: posts and comments
skool.note: read through a signed-in browser; Treg carries no read for it

places: the Whop groups joined, by link: posts and comments
whop.note: read through a signed-in browser; Treg carries no read for it

hand_off.crm: every kept lead, at once, through the conversation log
hand_off.partners: each community, chamber, association or newsletter owner found, added to the Dream lists and pointed to in requests/partners/

routines.sweep: Pick today's queue (daily, after Find Me Money's)
